title: Daily/weekly top-traded-token address-mining growth loop (offline pipeline; live trigger Owner-gated)
objective: Implement the daily/weekly growth loop from PROJECT_ARCHITECTURE.md section on the daily loop and blueprint section nine: (1) take a top-traded-token list for a window (daily and weekly are parameters) from the free borrow layer via the versioned parser into observations; (2) for each token pull Top Buyers/Sellers/Early Buyers/profit leaderboard (borrow path for speed); (3) run the detectors and Alpha Score over the addresses; (4) for wallets crossing the promotion bar, run first-hand Helius leaderboard confirmation; (5) sediment confirmed wallet-level conclusions into the address library; (6) emit a run report of tokens scanned, wallets mined, new smart-money/cluster/bot labels, and quota consumed. The whole pipeline is built and accepted OFFLINE on fixtures (a fixed top-token list plus fixture provider responses). The live top-list fetch and scheduled trigger are Owner-gated (decision D-F) and throttled against the Helius free 1M ceiling.
forbidden_actions: Do not perform live network fetches or scheduled runs in-stage; the live top-list fetch and scheduler are Owner-gated (D-F).
Do not exceed the configured first-hand recompute quota per run; when the budget is hit, stop and report what was skipped (no silent truncation).
Do not promote a borrowed leaderboard wallet to a confirmed library label without first-hand path-A confirmation.
Do not write a mined label without source, confidence, rule_version and a reversible evidence snapshot.
Do not put secrets, keys, credentials or raw provider payloads into the repo or fixtures.
